summary: Inotiv, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $65.5M debtor-in-possession credit facility on June 5, 2026, following its Chapter 11 filing on June 3, 2026. The DIP facility includes a $25M new money tranche (SOFR +11.5%, 4.5% upfront) and a $40.5M roll-up of prepetition bridge loans (3.5% upfront). The facility is superpriority secured and priming, with exit financing expected. The prepackaged plan of reorganization contemplates emergence. Watch for Bankruptcy Court approval, DIP budget constraints, and the conversion to exit term loans.
